title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S10 E05 — Wizard of Labs
John Henson challenges the bakers with high-velocity tornado desserts; the bakers get gooey as they present judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell with melted witch desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S10 E06 — Otherworldly Treats
John Henson catches a spirit in the X-ray room, and he wants the bakers to use its X-rays as templates for build-a-spirit desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S10 E07 — The Past Comes Back to Haunt You
The final bakers take on two very difficult challenges inspired by the past, all leading up to a time-traveling monster mash.

title: Keep Your Mind Sharp With the Memory Doctor's Brain Care Program
description: In this episode of Cognitive Care TV, senior brain health expert, Memory Doctor Daniel LaPerriere MD, shares his blueprint for keeping your mind sharp and quick as you age with his new Brain Care Program and clinically-tested NeuroQ Memory and Focus.

title: Ready for a safer shower? Enjoy a one-day bath remodel with Jacuzzi.
description: Trusted brand Jacuzzi Bath Remodel and interior designer Christina Hall share their secrets on how you can easily and affordably transform your bathroom into a gorgeous custom, safe, stylish space in 1 day! Call for a FREE quote & installation.

title: Get A Beautiful New Smile in 24 Hours
description: The Wellness Hour: Dr. Alvarez explores how Nuvia delivers a beautiful new smile in just 24 hours.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E04 — Korean BBQ
Esther Choi makes some favorite Korean classics; first, she picks the perfect flanken-cut short ribs for her Korean barbecue dish of LA Kalbi with Ssamjang; Esther's hot pot dish, Bulgogi Mushroom Jeongol, is all about savory bulgogi flavor.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E01 — Kimchi Time
Esther Choi teaches how to make two types of kimchi, a fast Mak Kimchi that's ready in just days, as well as Halmoni's Kimchi, her grandmother's recipe; plus, Esther shares how to make Kimchi Fried Rice and bossam, Korean Pork Belly Wraps.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
Family Time
Esther Choi makes Gyeran-Mari, a Korean rolled omelet, and Sweet Potato Pancakes, which are huge hits with her son, Leon; then, Esther shows how to make Nurungji Chicken, a whole roasted chicken cooked over sticky rice until the skin gets crispy.

title: Cooking With Choi
description:
S01 E06 — Korean Comfort Foods
Esther Choi shares some of her favorite Korean comfort foods; she makes a classic Korean rice roll, Kimbap, and takes it to the next level with a simple Ramyun; then, she pairs Seafood Japchae with Spinach Namul to keep things fresh and balanced.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S21 E07 — Back Office Bash
At the end of the workday, Ree Drummond and her team are having a casual office-warming party at their new space in town.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S30 E07 — One Potato, Two Potato
Ree Drummond spotlights different kinds of potatoes in a variety of delicious dishes; purple sweet potato soup with a pistachio crumble, corned beef hash with roasted russets and sweet potatoes, and potato dumplings with leftover mashed potatoes.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S33 E06 — No Fail Fall
Ree Drummond cooks some no-fail fall favorites, starting with an autumn steak salad and a one-pan fall chicken skillet, then, she prepares Santa Fe eggs in purgatory for an all-day breakfast and her quick mini chocolate tarts.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S36 E07 — Fall in Love
Ree Drummond is all about cozy, fall-inspired food; she serves up pecan-crusted pork chops with whiskey cream sauce, fruity glazed apple cider donuts, hearty root vegetables with spicy Italian sausage and creamy butternut squash fettuccine Alfredo.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S38 E07 — Simply Comfort 4 Ways
Broccoli chicken and cheese soup, outrageously cheesy creamy sage baked ravioli, meatless cauliflower parm, hazelnut hot chocolate made in the slow cooker.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S39 E13 — Family News
Ree Drummond shares family news while cooking for her kids; she makes Orange Chicken and Peppers for Paige and a French Onion Casserole for Alex to have after her baby is born; there are Totally Terrific Cookies and Sloppy Joes To Go for the boys.

title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
description:
S01 E05 — Pasta Dinner
Gabe makes hand-rolled Pici all'Aglione and delicate Raviolo al Uovo.

title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
description:
S01 E03 — Primo to Secondo
Chef Gabe Bertaccini takes our taste buds to central Italy, beginning with Crespelle alla Fiorentina, delicate Italian crêpes filled with creamy ricotta and spinach. Then, Lamb Chops Scottadito is made complete with a side of Herb Cast-Iron Potatoes.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S39 E01 — Stuff It!
The Kitchen hosts are making all things stuffed; Jeff Mauro kicks off the fun with his authentic Chicago style stuffed deep dish pizza; Geoffrey Zakarian fries up crispy pork and shrimp rolls; Katie Lee Biegel makes her unstuffed mushroom dip.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S36 E07 — Red Light Special Extravaganza
Guy Fieri has plenty of deals to welcome four chefs to Flavortown Market, with red light specials in all 10 aisles; using the red light specials, the chefs must create a fried feast before making a pork dish that's limited to 11 ingredients or fewer.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S37 E07 — Beat the Judges: Express Lane
Guy Fieri challenges three experienced chefs to prepare their best pork dish using only 10 items; the winner earns an automatic $15,000 and can wager up to $5,000 in an express lane seafood battle against the all-star judge of their choice.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S41 E05 — Food Family Takeover
Three restaurant crews featuring family and longtime employees compete.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E02 — Scary Sculpting
Each of the six carvers sculpt a 3D zombie in their likeness, complete with accessories that reflect their personality; the first team challenge requires creating a giant haunted house using a minimum of 15 pumpkins.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E03 — Sky-High Scares
Sunny challenges the carvers to reach new heights and build their biggest pumpkin creations yet, first bringing a frightening phobia to life and then depicting a circus sideshow gone terribly wrong.

title: Outrageous Pumpkins
description:
S03 E04 — Gourd Games
The final four carvers battle it out to earn the title of "Outrageous Pumpkins Champion"; they create a larger-than-life children's toy with a creepy spin; then, the carvers go all out with a sinister depiction of a popular playground pastime.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
Back from the Dead: Halloween All Stars: Part 1
Cake decorators, candy-makers and pumpkin carvers team up to compete to see who can make the biggest, wildest, and spookiest edible Halloween creations in an attempt to win a cash prize.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E02 — Back from the Dead: Things That Go Buzz in the Night
Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create terrifying insect-infested showpieces and daring buzz-worthy desserts inspired by coffee, tea and spirits; after an unexpected twist, judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller execute an elimination.

Trick or Eat
Duff and Maneet Chauhan challenge four fan favorites to create a Halloween mask pie using ingredients the bakers collect while trick-or-treating, but there is a sudden and shocking twist.

title: Worst Cooks in America
description:
S29 E01 — Talented & Terrible: Boot Camp's Got Talent
Chefs Anne Burrell and Gabe Bertaccini have just seven weeks to turn a talented bunch of culinary train wrecks into kitchen stars; the recruits kick things off with their signature showstopper dish and then tackle making a chicken dinner.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S31 E09 — Foolproof Fallbacks
Ree Drummond whips up dishes that can't go wrong, including chocolate sheet cake with vanilla bean frosting, stuffed peppers, simple Tex-Mex chicken spaghetti, and whiskey pot roast.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S34 E01 — Fresh and Fast
Ree Drummond puts a fresh spin on dinner with a one-pan chicken cauliflower skillet, saucy rustic turkey meatball pasta and an extra-fast orange ginger steak stir-fry; she also cooks grilled pita pizzas piled high with vegetables for a solo supper.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S39 E12 — Countertop Cooking
Ree Drummond is cooking on the countertop; she puts together a speedy all-in-one sausage and potato soup in the pressure cooker; then, the air fryer is perfect for a fast BBQ chicken bagel pizza; the microwave serves up a quick brownie bowl.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S40 E09 — More Cheese Please
Ree Drummond is getting cheesy; Mascarpone Cheesecake Bars get a cheery cherry topping; Oaxaca cheese and sharp cheddar elevate Cheese Enchiladas, Pepper Jack and Colby Jack team up in Beer Cheese for 2 and more.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S26 E06 — Fall for Your Pantry
Seasonal dishes using pantry staples; chicken bolognese; popovers with sesame butter and spiced pear jam; German-style sweet potato salad; lentil salad with mushrooms and pink lady apples; spicy bean dip.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S32 E11 — The Kitchen's Brunch in Bed
The ultimate cozy brunch menu; Geoffrey Zakarian whips classic Belgian waffles; Katie Lee Biegel shares her indulgent everything bagel cream cheese rolls; Sunny Anderson serves up a brown sugar cold brew.

title: Last Bite Hotel
description:
S01 E04 — Fire and Ice
Tituss Burgess welcomes VIP guests Esther Choi and Judy Joo, who request something spicy for dinner from the remaining four chefs; the chefs must use even more of their precious resources to make something icy cool for the guests.

title: Last Bite Hotel
description:
S01 E05 — A Midnight Check-In
There are only three chefs remaining as host Tituss Burgess welcomes VIP guest Andrew Zimmern for a late check-in; the competitors make a midnight snack, and in the morning, they use their dwindling ingredients to create stunning breakfast dishes.

title: Last Bite Hotel
description:
S01 E06 — The Last Bite
Tituss Burgess welcomes three VIP guests, Iron Chefs Alex Guarnaschelli, Cat Cora and Jose Garces to the hotel; the final competitors must impress the guests with a three-course meal to win the grand prize of 25,000 dollars.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Actress, comedian and foodie Aisha Tyler and Katie Lee Biegel get crafty.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E07 — The Bald and the Beautiful
Supermodel and swimwear designer Devon Windsor teams up with Chef Michael Symon to keep the drama high while chefs Dom Crisp and Santiago Guzzetti try to cook up a win against Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S36 E10 — Red Carpet Ready
Chef Katie Lee Biegel and fashion icon Carson Kressley glam it up; chefs Rob Reinsmith and Manny Barella dress Bobby Flay down.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:

Duff Goldman and actress Alyson Hannigan join forces with pastry pros Jewel Johnson and Katherine Sprung to take down Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay

Andrew Zimmern and Misty Copeland dance circles around Bobby Flay as chefs Tristen Epps and Vinnie Cimino make sure their plates are on point.

title: Beat Bobby Flay

Scott Conant and journalist Kaitlan Collins hope to report a loss by enlisting Beat Bobby Flay judges Hugh Mangum and Katie Pickens to take Bobby down.

title: Beat Bobby Flay

Brooke Williamson and actor Randall Park recruit chefs Marcos Spaziani and Richard Van Lê to teach Bobby Flay a thing or two about a tricky signature dish.

description: Discover the hidden story of OmegaXL with John Walsh. He dives deep into the groundbreaking supplement that promises hope and relief for millions battling joint pain and inflammation.

title: The Great Food Truck Race
description:
S17 E03 — Games on the Gulf: Pirates' Booty
Tyler Florence takes the teams to Lake Charles, La., where they plunder one another's trucks for a challenge judged by foodie pirates; thousands of customers swarm the trucks, stressing one team to implosion and propelling another to new heights.

title: The Great Food Truck Race
description:
S17 E04 — Games on the Gulf: Highway Robbery
Tyler Florence brings the teams into Biloxi, Miss., where they hope to rack up some big sales; however, none of them are prepared for the backlash when they get accused of price gouging.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E11 — Fry Day
Fieri has declared it Fry Day, and the returning champion takes on Jacob Town and Taylor Frankel in an epic battle for golden brown and delicious domination; Judges Mei Lin and Maneet Chauhan decide which chef takes home the gold and up to $20,000.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E12 — Seafood Day
Fieri challenges the chefs to a fish-filled food fight as the reigning champ casts their net for more riches against Cristina Topham and Lambert Givens; Judges Jonathon Sawyer and Michael Voltaggio decide who is the winner of this maritime madness.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E13 — Meat Lovers
Fieri fires up a meat lovers' showdown as the returning champ battles Quentin Garcia and Dominique Leach in making protein-packed plates; Maneet Chauhan and Michael Voltaggio judge who has enough sizzle to take home up to $20,000.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E14 — Egg Day
Guy Fieri hosts an Egg Day competition as a returning champ faces Leo Davila and Demetrio Zavala; judges Jonathon Sawyer and Nancy Silverton crown the eggs-treme winner.

title: Chopped
description:
S60 E04 — Legends: Maneet Chauhan
Four competitors return to the stoves after being hand-picked as favorites by judge Maneet Chauhan; the baskets that Maneet selects for this battle include a signature Nashville flavoring, an Indian dessert and a frozen cocktail.

title: Chopped
description:
S60 E01 — Legends: Scott Conant
Four champions return to the kitchen via personal invitation from judge Scott Conant; a notorious vegetable is a true test in the appetizer basket; in the second round, one chef hits a major hurdle when an ingredient falls to the floor.

title: Chopped
description:
S60 E03 — Legends: Alex Guarnaschelli
Four champions return to the kitchen as favorites of judge Alex Guarnaschelli; in the first round, a French pastry and a flavored fish are two pieces of the culinary puzzle that Alex has devised for her special group of competitors.

title: Chopped
description:
S60 E02 — Legends: Chris Santos
Four returning chefs are put to the test by legendary judge Chris Santos for a chance to compete in the tournament finale with Chris as their sous chef; a beautiful ode to bacon is one of the ingredients in the appetizer basket designed by Chris.

title: Chopped
description:
S60 E05 — Legends: Grand Finale
The best of the best face off to see who can emerge victorious in the tournament finale fight to win $25,000 in cash, $25,000 for charity and legendary status.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E03 — Venison Valor
An over-reduced sauce and undercooked venison are potential problems in the first round; with Mexican chocolate in the dessert basket, it seems like the judges are in for a treat; one of the chef's time management woes are worrying.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S26 E10 — Too Fly for Flay
Actress Nicole Ari Parker teams up with Sunny Anderson to take down Bobby Flay; husband-and-wife chefs Julio Lazzarini and Jennifer Behm-Lazzarini have to battle one another for a shot at Bobby.

title: Beat Bobby Flay

Entrepreneur Mark Cuban teams up with Sunny Anderson; they bring in vegan chefs Tamearra Dyson and Adyre Mason to seal the deal.

Hamilton star Christopher Jackson and Chef Josh Capon double-team Bobby Flay while chefs Edwin Bayonne and Kyle McClelland deep-fry his ego.

Sunny Anderson and actor Jenna Elfman team up with chefs Francisco Higareda and Chris Dodson to crush Bobby Flay with their international flavors.

Titan Michael Voltaggio's former mentor Kenny Gilbert is here to claim a spot on the Titans' couch. His Southern-inspired global dishes do impress James Beard Award-winning chef Nina Compton, but are they enough to secure the win?

Longtime Beat Bobby Flay judge Leah Cohen challenges Bobby Flay's home team chefs to a Southeast Asian showdown.

Jet Tila may be friends with Bobby Flay's Titans, but he's ready to be not so friendly to add Triple Threat Champion to his list of accolades and walk away with $25,000; global chef Lorena Garcia will be the judge of that.

Putting new twists on classic game day recipes, starting with Katie Lee's Buffalo Chicken Calzone and Sunny Anderson's Jalapeño Popper Dip.

Spiced lamb pastitsio; ham and cheese biscuits with honey Dijon butter; co-host Alex Guarnaschelli makes Grandma's smothered chicken with toasted garlic; glazed beets with crème fraîche and toasted pistachios.

S29 E10 — Recipe Swap!
Shaking things up with a new-school take on a recipe swap, where each host shares a dish made in another's signature style; short rib bourguignon over creamy polenta, crunchy orange French toast, pumpkin-spiced Irish coffee and more.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E07 — Alex vs Japan
Eric invites three Japanese chefs to take on Alex in a competition that's out of her comfort zone; judges Shota Nakajima and Tetsu Yahagi decide if they have what it takes to beat an Iron Chef in her own arena.

title: Alex vs. America
description:

Welcoming three chefs to use their skills with eggs to crack Alex's competition prowess; in a blind judging, Brooke Williamson and Michael Voltaggio.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E03 — Alex vs Frozen Desserts
Eric Adjepong challenges three cool treat chefs to take on Alex; Duff Goldman and Natasha Case judge as the chefs try to keep their cool to beat Alex.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E02 — Alex vs New York City
Eric Adjepong invites three competitors from Alex Guarnaschelli's home city of New York to represent the city's diverse cuisine; judges Marcus Samuelsson and Leah Cohen keep the Big Apple in mind as the chefs use their skills to vie for the top spot.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S29 E10 — April Fools' Rules
In honor of legendary chef and prankster Carl "The Cuban" Ruiz, Guy Fieri invites Carl's all-star friends to Flavortown Market for a night of epic food and twisted pranks; the chefs prepare a spicy appetizer and an even spicier entrée.
